🚀 **Introducing a New Update System!**

We've introduced a brand-new app update system to make future updates easier and more convenient. Stay informed about the latest releases and enjoy a smoother, more streamlined update experience.

⚡ **Performance Improvements**

Optimized overall app performance to deliver a smoother, faster, and more responsive experience. Various internal improvements have been made to enhance app efficiency and reliability.

🛠️ **Bug Fixes & Stability**

Fixed minor bugs, addressed existing issues, and improved overall app stability. Several behind-the-scenes refinements help deliver a more consistent experience.

✨ **Additional Improvements**

Made various internal optimizations and small enhancements to improve the overall app experience and reliability.
